entity_raw.definition_raw:
You have a strong connection to a particular legend, Which empowers the spirits you channel.

Prerequisite(s): Spirit bonus class feature.

Benefit(s): Select a legend of spirits. Your spirit bonus from spirits of that legend increases by 1.
